title: Coronary Artery Aneurysm Registry
brief_summary: International registry gathering patients with angiographically confirmed coronary aneurysm.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria (angiographic diagnosis):

* Coronary aneurysm: focal coronary dilatation which exceeds the diameter of normal adjacent segments or the diameter of the patient's largest coronary vessel by 1.5 times.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient ´s refusal to participate.
study_population: All patients with a coronary aneurysm diagnosis.
